confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors draw on several mostly 2026-dated aggregated sources (Numbeo, combien-coute, Whereandwhen, Welt-preise) and are the most reliable. Wine and cocktail anchors rest on a few Aix venue menus, sanity-checked against the beer level, so they are less certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic peak-July estimates and were not checked against any listings. Beer is a 0.5 L draught. Euro prices were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which was not taken from the searches and moves all USD anchors proportionally. The FX value is as reported in search results for the RBA exchange-rates page and was not re-verified on the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink anchors are Aix-specific, drawn from venue menus and city-level aggregates. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for mid-sized Provence cities with a July tourist premium in Aix.
